theme_strategy: Hybrid 'Performance Pro' & 'Swiss High-Contrast'. The web panel favors crisp, high-contrast structural grayscale, while the Cashier Screen and Kitchen Display lean into an elite, command-center dark mode (Obsidian base) with high-visibility kinetic triggers. Full Light/Dark toggle support across all panels.

headings.rules: Tracking-tight for all headers above text-2xl. Use for Page Titles, Cart Totals, and Dashboard KPI numbers.

body.rules: Optimal for tabular data, numbers, and dense POS item lists. Leading-relaxed for readability.

arabic_rtl.rules: Ensure all layout grids flip via dir='rtl' classes (e.g., ms-4 instead of ml-4).

colors.rules: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays. Use tinted grays. Avoid full-screen gradients. Provide stark contrast for POS elements (e.g., Bright red 'Clear Cart' button).

merchant_panel.grid: Bento Protocol Mode B (High Density). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
merchant_panel.cards: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-lg max 8px). 1px border. No soft shadows. Use Grid Borders technique.

cashier_pos.structure: Mobile-first responsive. Desktop: Grid cols-12. Left section (Products) spans col-span-8 or 9. Right section (Cart/Till) spans col-span-4 or 3.
cashier_pos.product_grid: Grid Borders style. border-collapse, minimal gaps, large touch targets (min h-16).
cashier_pos.cart_panel: Sticky right sidebar. h-[calc(100vh-4rem)]. Overflow-y-auto. Tactile Neumorphism for the numpad/quick cash buttons.
cashier_pos.touch_targets: Ensure all actionable buttons are min h-12 to h-14 for touch-friendly POS operation.

kitchen_display.structure: Command center horizontal layout. Multi-column Kanban board for tickets.
kitchen_display.ticket_card: High contrast. Timers must use tabular-nums. Color-code ticket headers based on time (Green < 10m, Yellow > 10m, Red > 20m).

restaurant_map.structure: Interactive canvas area. Tables represented as absolute positioned nodes or flex-wrap shapes.
restaurant_map.table_status: Use border colors and subtle pulses for table states (Available, Occupied, Ordered, Paying).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Tactile Neumorphism' for POS NumPad (1px sharp border + soft drop shadow). Use 'Grid Borders' for dashboard tables.
visual_enhancers.offline_badge: Must feature a glowing pulse animation (framer-motion or ping tailwind class) when in offline/sync-pending mode.
visual_enhancers.modals: Payment and Checkout Modals must use 'Crystal Glass' backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 (dark) or bg-white/70 (light) to retain context.

component_rules.general: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for macro layouts. ALWAYS use Shadcn for Form, Select, Dialog, Dropdown, Table, and Tabs.
component_rules.buttons: Sharp buttons (rounded-md max). Use scale-down on active state (active:scale-95) for tactile POS feedback.
component_rules.tables: Dashboard data tables must use row striping or 1px bottom borders. Align monetary values right.
component_rules.toasts: Use Sonner for offline sync notifications and system alerts. Position bottom-right for Dashboard, top-center for POS.
component_rules.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn) for Merchant Dashboard. Monochrome bars or lines with primary brand color accents.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure POS items and text pass WCAG AA. Avoid gray-on-gray.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Disable intense pulses if set.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='pos-add-to-cart', data-testid='checkout-button').

image_urls.description: Modern coffee shop interior for login screen background or hero.
High quality burger and fries for POS product grid population.
Cashier scanning payment, useful for onboarding or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute the 'Performance Pro' archetype for the POS and Kitchen screens. They must feel like high-end tactical interfaces, not standard SaaS apps.
Implement the offline-first logic visually with a distinct top-bar badge (yellow/orange) that says 'Pending Sync' with a 'Sync Now' CTA.
POS screen on mobile must hide the product grid behind a toggle or stack vertically with the cart fixed at the bottom sheet.
For multi-language/Arabic, wrap the application layout in a dir wrapper based on language state. Rely on Tailwind's logical properties (e.g., ps-4, pe-4, ms-4).
Install required icons: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react (best for dense dashboard and POS action buttons).
Avoid using generic centered content. Make aggressive use of space and alignment.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Create depth with z-index hierarchy and 1px sharp borders. Do not use dark colors as gradients. Do NOT apply universal transitions ('transition: all') to avoid breaking transforms. Do NOT center align the app container. Never use AI emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing. Prioritize reusing Shadcn components (Sonner, Dialog, Table, Tabs).
